sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 11632 of 2024

Applicant :- Munna Lal
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko

Counsel for Applicant :- Ashutosh Bajpai
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.516 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B, 302 IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Hardi, District Bahraich.
3. It is argued by the Counsel for the applicant that the co-accused, the father-in-law has been enlarged on bail vie order dated 26.07.2024 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.8102 of 2024.

sentences.text: Although the applicant is not claiming exact parity with the said co-accused.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering and adopting the same reasoning as contained in the order dated 26.07.2024 and the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is in custody since 09.10.2023, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicantMunna Lal be released on bail in the abovesaid first information report number on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 7.11.2024 akverma  Munna Lal vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko on 7 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/4845861/
